historical_record.description: On its naming committee's recommendation, the Recreation and Park Commission named the tennis courts to be built on top of the Lombard Street Reservoir the Alice Marble Tennis Courts, for the San Francisco-born world and national champion.
The Alice Marble Tennis Courts at Greenwich and Hyde Streets were to be officially dedicated on Saturday morning, November 18, as announced to the Recreation and Park Commission.
